alate: Alate entirely dark. Head broadly oval; postclypeus pale, several times as wide as long; fontanelle small, mostly elongate and forked; antennal segments not much elongate; posterior margins of the meso- and metanotum rather widely concave; forewing scale and hindwing scale similar in size; radial vein absent; media and cubitus very close together.
soldier: Small individuals: head yellowish brown, nasus reddish brown, frontal gland tube visible, antennae nearly concolorous with head, pronotum pale yellowish brown with anterior part pale reddish brown, meso- and metanotum and legs yellow, chaetotaxy as in large individuals. Head rather broadly pear-shaped, widest at the mid-posterior part; nasus rounded and tubular, in profile slightly obliquely upturned, vertex slightly convex, a small tubercle on each side of the nasus base; mandibular apical teeth distinct; antennae 13-segmented, segment III longer than II and IV, II and IV about equal in length. Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior part upturned, the emarginations at the middle of the anterior and posterior margins both indistinct. Tibial spur formula 2:2:2; tarsi 4-segmented. Large individuals: head circular or elongate-oval, nasus projecting from before the frons, tubular or conical, narrow anteriorly and thick posteriorly; head not constricted at the middle, junction of vertex and nasus straight or slightly concave, no constriction behind the antennal sockets; mandibles very small, anterolateral corners blunt, or with a pointed spine projecting; antennal segments not much elongate; labrum extremely short.
worker: Workers also occur in two sizes. Large individuals: head reddish brown, pale T-shaped suture distinct, antennae yellowish brown, pronotum coloured like the antennae, legs yellowish brown, setae on the head sparse. Head somewhat broadly circular, widest behind the antennal sockets, fontanelle circular and depressed, situated just behind the intersection of the T-suture, postclypeus convex; antennae 15-segmented, segment II longer than III or IV; pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin concave, median emargination of the posterior margin indistinct. Small individuals: head paler than in large individuals, chaetotaxy the same; head square with rounded corners, postclypeus convex, antennae 14-segmented, segment IV shortest; pronotum saddle-shaped, median emargination of the anterior margin distinct, that of the posterior margin indistinct.
